company.name: Amagi Media Labs
company.shortDescription: Amagi Media Labs is a media technology company that offers cloud-based solutions for broadcast and connected TV.
company.description:
Amagi Media Labs is a media technology company that offers cloud-based solutions for broadcast and connected TV. The company facilitates the geographic targeting of TV advertisements. It is a unique mix of media and innovation that has made way for a new TV-media advertising platform. Amagi brings services that are cost-effective, powerful, focused, and result-oriented.

Headquartered in New York, Amagi was founded in 2008.

aiResearchSummary.text: Amagi Media Labs focuses on cloud-based broadcast and connected TV workflows. Content decisioning in zero-slate for streaming platforms, zero-slate for streaming platforms, and replacement decisioning in zero-slate for streaming platforms describe systems for personalized linear channels, dynamic content ladders, ad replacement and load balancing to avoid filler slates and ad fatigue. Programmatic media content exchange between content owners and ott content details programmatic distribution and media asset management. These efforts target zero slate streaming, personalization, ad optimization and programmatic exchange.
